annotations.text: Possibility and necessity drawn as the shape of a derivation, not as a modal mark (docs/MODALITY_WITHOUT_GAMMA.md §1, the trajectory reading). The worlds are the four reachable sheets; accessibility is the legal-transition DAG. src/modal_query.py reads ◇/□ off it: □(cold) holds (cold is on every reachable sheet — necessity as convergence), while ◇(cloudy) and ◇(calm) hold without □ (each on some sheet but not all — possibility as branching).

Two legal lines of development drop (cloudy) and (calm) in either order and converge on (cold). Every edge is a sound ERA in a positive context (a relinquishment the rules license), so the whole frame is §3.3-attestable — the modal frame is drawn and checkable, never asserted by a glyph.
